task.title: Run one runtime event through telemetry and reconciliation to a terminal incident

scope.owned_layer: Paper-runtime telemetry acceptance, reconciliation DriftReport persistence, and terminal incident identifier handoff for Evolution.
not_changing: incidents service ownership or persistence implementation
live-capital activation, broker credentials, or RuntimeBinding authority

composes_with.upstream: L12-MIN-CAP-20260808 emits the paper-only paper_fill_simulated runtime event.
composes_with.downstream: L12-MIN-EVO-20260808 consumes terminal_incident_id from the reconciliation worker result.

normal_path_proof.mode: deterministic, isolated in-process telemetry and reconciliation integration
normal_path_proof.trigger: One paper-only Capital paper_fill_simulated runtime event with a committed ledger fill.
event_sequence: TelemetryIngestService accepts the schema-valid Capital event and retains its immutable accepted-event readback.
The telemetry-owned runtime summary records the same event, binding, and runtime identity.
The existing reconciliation telemetry-consume endpoint evaluates the fill_quantity breach, persists DriftReport drift-evt-l12-min-cap-runtime-001, and calls the existing incident classifier.
Consumer, scheduler, and incident-listener worker results expose deduplicated terminal_incident_ids and a single terminal_incident_id when one terminal incident is present.

acceptance.statement: Consume the Capital runtime event through the existing telemetry ingest.
Run reconciliation and persist one terminal DriftReport or IncidentCase.
Expose the terminal incident identifier for Evolution input.
Do not add unrelated incident service or infrastructure hardening.

commands.conclusion: 79 passed, 1 skipped (optional PANTHEON_TEST_NATS_URL crash probe), 1 existing Starlette TestClient deprecation warning

safety.no_live_capital: pass; the test event asserts is_real_order=false and is_real_capital=false.
safety.incident_ownership: unchanged; reconciliation uses the existing incident classifier boundary and does not alter the incidents service.
safety.infrastructure: unchanged; the optional real JetStream crash probe remains separately environment-gated.

review.required_review: Verify the paper-only Capital event, immutable telemetry readback, persisted DriftReport, terminal incident identifier handoff, focused validation, and task scope before approving this manifest through the governed status command.
